data.name: L.V. Access Point Distribution Box (JKF3008)
data.model: Model: JKF3008 | Main Components: Schneider Electric & Chint

descriptionBlocks.value:
General Overview
* Asset Tag/ID: JKF3008 (检修分箱 - Access Points Panel)
* Main Power Source: Incoming supply directly fed from L.V. Room (Panel Ref: GHL-26D5)
* Main System Capacity: 100 AMP Rating (Total Box Panel controlled via 2Q1 main circuit)

     Internal Component Breakdown
* Main Busbars: 3-Phase Heavy Duty Copper Busbars (Red, Yellow, Blue) + Neutral Bar mounted with insulation boots on the chassis.
* Main Molded Case Circuit Breakers (MCCBs): 2x Schneider Electric high-capacity industrial breakers with thermal-magnetic trip units for primary isolation.
* Miniature Circuit Breakers (MCBs): 3x Chint/Schneider rail-mounted MCBs tagged as 1Q1, 2Q1, and 3Q1 for localized branch circuit distribution.
* Heavy Duty AC Contactor: 1x Industrial power contactor (wired underneath the MCBs) with secondary auxiliary contacts for automation/remote switching control.
* Terminal Blocks & Grounding: Multi-port ceramic/phenolic terminal strip array at the bottom right for field wiring connections, linked directly to the sub-station grounding grid.

### External Enclosure Features
* Enclosure Type: Wall-mounted IP-rated metallic distribution panel with protective top and bottom ventilated red grilles.
* External Status Indicators: Door-mounted Phase Indication Pilot Lights (1x Green, 1x Red) showing real-time panel live status without opening the door.

instructionBlocks.value:
### Sequential Installation Guide

* **Step 1: Structural Mounting**
  Fix the IP-rated metallic enclosure securely to the designated wall structure using heavy-duty masonry rawlbolts. Ensure leveling is accurate to avoid physical stress on internal switchgear.

* **Step 2: Main Supply Line Pulling**
  Route the main 3-phase incoming armored cables safely from the L.V. Room (GHL-26D5) through the bottom cable gland plate of the panel.

* **Step 3: Busbar & Core Cable Termination**
  Terminate the main Red, Yellow, Blue (R-Y-B) phase lines and the Neutral line directly onto the copper busbar terminals. Tighten all nuts using a calibrated torque wrench to prevent future loose-contact heating.

* **Step 4: Sub-distribution Wiring**
  Connect the output loads to the respective Chint/Schneider 1Q1, 2Q1, and 3Q1 breaker terminals sequentially. Ensure the auxiliary contactor circuit is correctly looped to the control signal wires.

* **Step 5: Earthing Connection**
  Bond the panel's main chassis grounding terminal firmly to the plant's dedicated copper grounding loop to prevent accidental electric shock hazards.

* **Step 6: Pilot Light & Door Interlock Check**
  Wire the external door-mounted indicator lamps (Red/Green) to the incoming side of the main breaker. Test the mechanical door latch and lock system for final closure.

### CRITICAL SAFETY INSTRUCTIONS

* **LOTO Protocol Mandatory:** Always execute complete Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) procedures at the upstream L.V. Room source breaker (GHL-26D5) before opening or working inside this panel.
* **Voltage Verification:** Use a certified digital multimeter to verify zero voltage across all three copper busbars before attempting any component replacement.
* **Cable Management:** Ensure all internal tangled wires at the bottom are neatly bundled and zipped using heat-resistant cable ties to prevent contact with sharp metallic edges.
* **PPE Requirement:** Technicians must wear rated Arc Flash face shields, insulated safety boots, and 1000V-rated dielectric gloves during maintenance or live checking phases.

data.name: Honeywell SmartLine Pressure Transmitter
data.model: Model: SmartLine ST700/ST800 Series | Manufacturer: Honeywell

descriptionBlocks.value:
### General Overview
* **Device Type:** Industrial Smart Differential/Gauge Pressure Transmitter.
* **Primary Application:** Real-time monitoring of high-pressure boiler feed water discharge line loops.
* **Current Operational Display:** High-contrast digital LCD showing a live line pressure of **6.1 MPa** (Megapascals), which equals 61 Bar or approximately 884.7 PSI.

### Core Component Breakdown
* **Transmitter Housing/Enclosure:** Weatherproof, explosion-proof die-cast aluminum epoxy-coated blue/gray housing (IP66/67 rated) to protect internal electronics from extreme dust and moisture.
* **Digital Display Window:** Circular glass cover housing a backlit alphanumeric LCD screen that provides real-time process variable (PV) tracking, unit display, and diagnostic bars.
* **Process Connection (Impulse Inlet):** Bottom-mounted stainless steel female NPT connection linked directly via a rigid steel impulse pipe loop to avoid thermal transfer from the process fluid.
* **Electrical/Signal Entry:** Side-mounted threaded conduit entry equipped with an armored cable gland for heavy-duty 2-wire loop power connection.
* **Local Configuration Buttons:** Internal buttons hidden under the nameplate ring for zero/span calibration and field setup adjustments.

instructionBlocks.value:
### Sequential Installation Guide

* **Step 1: Bracket Mounting & Positioning**
  Fix the transmitter assembly securely to a stable 2-inch pipe mounting bracket or structural wall manifold to shield the internal sensor from heavy pipe vibrations.

* **Step 2: Impulse Line Plumbing**
  Run the small-bore stainless steel or copper impulse line from the main boiler feed pipe to the instrument's bottom adapter. Ensure an inline isolation valve (blue handle) is integrated for maintenance.

* **Step 3: Signal Cable Routing & Termination**
  Thread the shielded twisted-pair signal wire (usually 24V DC loop powered) through the explosion-proof conduit. Terminate the positive (+) and negative (-) leads onto the terminal block inside the rear compartment.

* **Step 4: Mechanical Leak Check & Venting**
  Crack open the process valve slightly to allow fluid into the transmitter sensor cavity. Carefully bleed any trapped air pockets using the integrated vent plug until a steady liquid stream appears, then tighten.

* **Step 5: Loop Power & Calibration Verification**
  Power up the instrument loop. Confirm that the local Honeywell LCD screen boots up properly and aligns perfectly with the telemetry system or DCS readings in the control room.







### CRITICAL SAFETY INSTRUCTIONS

* **High Pressure Risk:** The transmitter is monitoring an active pressure loop of **6.1 MPa**. Never attempt to loosen the device from its process connection, open the conduit, or unscrew the bleed ports while the line is live and under pressure.
* **Isolation (LOTO) Requirement:** Before doing any calibration, replacement, or testing, completely close the primary isolation needle valve and safely vent down the residual internal pressure to **0.0 MPa**.
* **Explosion-Proof Integrity:** Ensure the terminal enclosure cover is screwed on completely tight and the cable gland is securely sealed to maintain its flame-proof and weather-proof field ratings.
* **Thermal Protection:** The process water line can transfer intense heat up the impulse piping. Always wear certified high-temperature safety gloves when interacting with the instrument manifold or venting valves.

* **Working:** Yeh ek **Dry-type (Cast Resin) Transformer** hai jo bina kisi oil ke chalta hai, isliye isme short-circuit ya aag lagne ka khatra bohot kam hota hai. Yeh high-voltage grid supply (11 kV) ko step down karke utility level low voltage (400 V) par lekar aata hai. Internal cooling ke liye isme automatic temperature controlled fans (AF) lagaye ja sakte hain.
* **Purpose:** Iska main maqsad ==Transformer Chemical House== aur pure RO Plant ke low-voltage MNS/GCK distribution panels ko safe aur continuous electricity supply dena hai.

instructionBlocks.value:
1. **Isolate power completely** from both High-Voltage (HV) incoming breaker and Low-Voltage (LV) outgoing breaker before opening the doors.
2. Verify that the enclosure winding temperature indicator (display controller on the side panel) is working and showing normal ambient readings.
3. Check ventilation louvers and top enclosure vents for blockages to ensure **proper airflow (AN/AF cooling)**.
4. ==De-dust and vacuum clean== the epoxy resin cast coils periodically using non-metallic extensions to prevent dust accumulation and flashovers.
5. Inspect all electrical connections, grounding busbars, and cable terminations for tight torque specifications and signs of overheating.

* > ⚠️ **==DANGER: HIGH VOLTAGE (高压危险)==** — Enclosure ke andar live parts hain. Jab tak system completely isolate aur ground na ho jaye, doors ko hargiz na kholein.
* > 🛑 **Never bypass temperature controllers** or internal thermal relay sensors attached to the transformer core.
* > Ensure the enclosure ground connection is physically intact before re-energizing the unit.
